name: ZMP riboswitch bound to AICAR monophosphate
source: RCSB PDB 4XW7; Kim PB et al. Nature 2015 doi:10.1038/nature14816
notes: ZTP/ZMP riboswitch from Fusobacterium ulcerans. Ligand AMZ (ZMP = AICAR monophosphate, 1 phosphate). 2.50A X-ray. Companion to 6WZS (ZTP, 3 phosphates) — tests monophosphate vs triphosphate scoring.
